subject.title: chore(docker): bundle channel voice plugin deps

question: Should unset Docker builds pre-bundle Discord, Feishu, and Voice Call dependencies, or should these official plugins remain opt-in and installed on demand?
rationale: The PR changes a public image-content default with operator upgrade costs, while current documentation and official release jobs do not establish this three-plugin set as intended policy.

options.title: Keep plugins opt-in
options.body: Retain the current empty default and continue installing these official plugins on demand or through an explicit `OPENCLAW_EXTENSIONS` value.

options.title: Pre-bundle across all images
options.body: Approve the trio as a canonical default and update local and official image paths together with upgrade and real-image proof.

recommendation.title: Keep plugins opt-in
recommendation.body: Retain the current empty default and continue installing these official plugins on demand or through an explicit `OPENCLAW_EXTENSIONS` value.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the Docker extension-dependency mechanism and merged the closest official-image keep-list precedent.
